what_to_detect: An infinity ability (a trigger conditioned on its permanent being harnessed, IsPresent$ Card.Self+harnessed) is evaluated while the permanent is harnessed and fires.
near_miss: The same infinity trigger is evaluated while its permanent is not harnessed and does not fire.
record_fields: sidecar trigger line script IsPresent$ Card.Self+harnessed

Forge scripts the infinity ability as a trigger always present on the card with an IsPresent$ harnessed condition, so the trigger record is written on both sides; trigger_mode reads Mode$, Origin$, Destination$ and ValidCard$ only, and Mode$ alone (Phase) matches every beginning-of-step trigger.
